name: Ola metric switch and chart playback
authoredWith: Figma Motion manual keyframes via use_figma

implementation.target: Metric number, count, chart and axes group; native dropdown remains static.
implementation.trigger: Replay once after the metric or currency changes.
implementation.conversionNote: The authoritative Figma export below retains its original 700ms entries and 1800ms line reveal. Following the user’s request for faster motion, the app plays the entry and axis tracks at 4.375x speed (160ms), and the chart draw at 4.5x speed (400ms). Keyframes and easing are preserved; the default hold and infinite repeat are omitted.
implementation.renderingAdaptation: The app reveals an always-solid polyline through a 400ms SVG clip rectangle instead of normalized stroke dashes. The clip rectangle covers the full plot and stroke endpoints after completion. No forward-filled transform remains; reduced motion uses the full static clip. The original Figma motion export is preserved below.

studyVerification.fontFallback: Inter in the motion study because the platform system fonts were unavailable; keep the application's existing font stack.
